items.title: Timberwolves waive Enrique Freeman following minor injury
items.author: Yahoo Sports
items.body_excerpt: Timberwolves waive Enrique Freeman following minor injury Yahoo Sports

items.title: The Minnesota Timberwolves will waive two-way forward Enrique Freeman, who’s dealing with a minor injury that’ll keep him out for a few weeks, sources told HoopsHype. He averaged 16.5 points on 54.2% shooting, 8.7 rebounds, and 2.4 assists last season with the Iowa Wolves.
items.author: Michael Scotto

quote.author: Michael Scotto
quote.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves and Norchad Omier have agreed to a two-way deal, league sources told HoopsHype. Omier averaged 18.3 points on 59.2% shooting from the field, 11.4 rebounds, and 2.5 assists in the G League last season.

items.author: NBA.com

items.title: The Wolves are bringing back Enrique Freeman on a 2-way contract, per source. They had one open 2-way, looked at several options. Freeman is well-liked and has familiarity with the system. He will begin in Iowa.

items.title: The Timberwolves have waived Enrique Freeman, KJ Martin, Norchad Omier, Antonio Reeves and Drew Timme
items.author: Ryan Eichten
items.body_excerpt:
The Timberwolves have waived Enrique Freeman, KJ Martin, Norchad Omier, Antonio Reeves and Drew Timme

They now have an open two-way roster spot to go along with Rocco Zikarsky and Zyon Pullin
